name: Nancy Green
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in New York, New York
about: Attorney Nancy Green is a partner at the highly respected New York City law firm of Green Kaminer Min & Rockmore LLP, which she co-founded in 2007. Having focused the majority of her career on family law, Ms. Green continues to focus her practice on divorce and other family-related matters by offering representation and guidance to clients from throughout New York state who face a variety of legal issues, including the following:
• High-asset divorce• Property division• Spousal support• Child support• Child custody• International family law
In addition to her primary practice area, Ms. Green also assists clients with needs related to trusts and estates, along with offering real estate transaction services.

Ms. Green began her legal career in 1992 after earning her law degree from Brooklyn Law School. In addition to her approval to practice law in all of New York's state courts, the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York have also issued their approvals for her to practice in their courtrooms, as has the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit. These multi-level approvals allow her to offer clients assistance regardless of the court with jurisdiction.

Since the beginning of Ms. Green's nearly 30-year legal career, she has earned a place among the Northeast's leading lawyers. Her excellent reputation has earned her a number of honors, including an "Excellent" rating from Avvo.

Ms. Green is an active member of the legal community. She is a member of the New York State Bar Association, the Association of the Bar of the City of New York, New York County Lawyers Association, the Association of Family and Conciliation Courts, the American Academy for Certified Financial Litigators and the New York Women's Bar Association. She was also accepted as a fellow in the International Academy of Family Lawyers. She was recently selected by Doyle's Guide as a Leading Family, Matrimonial and Divorce Law.
